gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).

gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).

gaps.sentence: Please fill ___ this form and sign at the bottom.
gaps.explanation: fill in/out a form (British prefers in).

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.
